headline: A new study is raising questions about whether data centres are a good deal for Ohio, Cleveland.com reports.
score_reason: Pool score 5 lowered to 4: the article could not be read, so the study's findings are unverified.
importance_line: Ohio residents and local governments weighing data centre deals may get new numbers on costs and benefits, but the headline alone does not say who wrote the study or what it found.
summary: Cleveland.com reports that a new study raises questions about whether data centres are a good deal for Ohio and picks out five numbers from it.
notes: Cleveland.com article blocked (HTTP 403); headline only. An Ohio Capital Journal headline of 8 Oct about a study saying a construction ban would beat the status quo may concern the same study; not verified, not used.
